title: Post something pretty
description:
Take a photo and post it on social media.
The photo must get at least 10 likes or equivalent within 10 minutes.
Team members may not participate.

title: Know someone who lives around here
description:
Visit a house or building where someone you personally know used to live or currently lives. 
Tell your team about it.

title: Photograph a cat
description: The cat must be an actual real life cat.

title: Write an ode to another team
description:
Send a complementary poem to another team.
The poem must be positive about the other team.
The poem must include a rhyme for each of the other team’s names.
The poem must be at least 8 lines long.

title: Stalk a squirrel
description: Film a squirrel without interruption for 2 minutes.

title: Attend a local event
description:
The event must have at least 10 people in attendance.
The event must have some kind of public advertisement (facebook event, web page, poster).
You must attend for at least 10 minutes.

title: Visit an interesting thing
description:
Choose a thing. The thing must be a specific individual physical thing, not a type of thing. The thing may not be the neighbourhood hub.
After choosing your thing, search for a video about the thing. If there is a video with more than 500 views, you complete this challenge. If not, you fail.
The video must mention or directly reference the thing in the title.

title: Give your teammate a genuine compliment
description:
Choose one team member. 
Each other team member must give them a genuine compliment.

title: Run for local election
description:
Make three promises about how you will improve this neighbourhood.
You must make a promise outside of a school, library, church or park. 
You may not use the same type of location more than once.

title: Play a musical instrument
description:
Play a real musical instrument.
The instrument cannot be improvised, or something you have with you.

title: Have Fun
description:
Have fun for 15 minutes.
You must be doing a fun activity for the entire 15 minutes.
Your fun activity cannot be a mode of travel.

title: Report a pothole
description:
Complete a pothole report using the city's official pothole reporting website.
The report must be accurate.

title: Find something from your tattoo
description:
Find something that a team member has a tattoo of.
The thing must be physical and the main subject of the tattoo.
If nobody on your team has a tattoo, draw a new challenge.
